heat_capacity_J_per_K.source: Nominal mass 69.25 g (Piombo et al. 2024, Table 1) x assumed specific heat 1000 J/(kg K); not measured

ambient_conductance_W_per_K.source: Cth/tau with tau = 465.9 s fitted to the measured post-discharge cooling of Piombo test 53 (reports/thermal_v1/cooling_derivation.json); in-sample, chamber-specific

neighbour_conductance_W_per_K.source: Assumed weak cell-to-cell coupling through copper bars and air; not identified from data

rail_heat_to_cells_fraction.source: Assumed: half of each rail-segment loss heats its two adjacent cells equally; the rest leaves to ambient
